summary: The change adds a single-use handoff link. It lets the browser that Halo desktop opens finish an integration setup without a sign-in. It also binds the OAuth callback to that browser's setup cookie or the owner's session. F3 is resolved by a temp test that checks mountHaloApp passes its host to HaloAppRoutes. Both test tiers pass, the coverage gate passes with exemptions I accept, and no findings remain.
